description: The UserController.java is a Spring MVC controller class managing user-related actions within an admin interface, including listing users, changing passwords, creating/editing users, removing users, and resetting passwords with security questions.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing user administration functions such as listing, creating, editing, deleting users, and password management.

methods.name: displayUsers
methods.description: Displays the user list page for administrators.

methods.name: pageUsers
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch and paginate user list data.

methods.name: displayChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the change password form for authenticated users.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes password change requests, validates input, and updates user password.

methods.name: displayUserCreate
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new user.

methods.name: displayUserEdit
methods.description: Loads user data for editing based on user ID.

methods.name: populateUserObjects
methods.description: Populates model attributes with user groups, stores, security questions, languages for user forms.

methods.name: displayUser
methods.description: Prepares and displays the user creation/edit form with existing or new user data.

methods.name: checkUserCode
methods.description: Checks whether a username code already exists for uniqueness validation.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Handles the creation or update of user data, including validation, email notification, and group assignment.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for user pages.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset by fetching security questions for a username.

methods.name: resetPasswordSecurityQtn
methods.description: Completes password reset by verifying security questions and sending the new password via email.
